input.quote: 14.3 Certain Additional Consequences of Termination. In the event of any termination of this Agreement pursuant to Section 14.2, then, if SFJ has not caused a Program Transfer to occur pursuant to Section 3.20:
input.rationale: No provision gives PB a general post-exit transition and data-export right. Section 14.3 is doubly conditional (only terminations under Section 14.2, and only if no Program Transfer has occurred), so it does not apply on expiration; its deliverables are assignments of Product Filings and Trial Data Package within a redacted period, and the only continuation of activity (14.3.4(ii)) is a redacted clinical-trial transfer period rather than a stated assistance duration. Section 10.3 covers return of Confidential Information at the Disclosing Party's direction with no export deadline. We therefore insert the shortest fallback-level clause: assistance for at least 90 days and export of our data within 30 days after any expiration or termination. We did not add then-current rates, machine-readable format or deletion certification, which are preferred-level extras.

ops.text: 14.5 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or any termination of this Agreement, SFJ shall provide PB with transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and shall export and deliver to PB, within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, all data, records and materials generated, collected or held by SFJ or its Affiliates relating to the Product or the Clinical Trials.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a short exit provision so that, on any expiration or termination, SFJ provides at least 90 days of transition assistance and exports our Product and Clinical Trial data to us within 30 days. Section 14.3 only applies to Section 14.2 terminations where no Program Transfer has occurred and sets no export deadline, so this sits at our fallback position.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 14.5 requiring 90 days of transition assistance and 30-day data export on expiry or termination.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
